il2cpp_abi.hidden_method_info_rule: In IL2CPP ARM64 generated code, every managed method receives a hidden 'const MethodInfo*' pointer as the last parameter. For static methods: f(arg0, arg1, ..., MethodInfo* method). For instance methods: f(this, arg0, arg1, ..., MethodInfo* method). In internal calls between IL2CPP methods, the MethodInfo* is passed in the next available general-purpose argument register (e.g., x2 for 2-arg static, x1 for 1-arg static). Horizon OS native wrappers can pass NULL if the method body does not dereference MethodInfo (or pass the resolved MethodInfo* for safety).
il2cpp_abi.value_type_return_rule: AAPCS64 requires structs larger than 16 bytes (or non-HFA) to be returned indirectly via caller-allocated buffer whose pointer is passed in register x8. Verified in Input.GetTouch (UnityEngine.Touch is 0x44 / 68 bytes; x8 is preserved in x19, then passed in x0 to memcpy).
